input.content:
STAGE: final ranking (complete answer)
GOAL: place all four proposals 1..4 under rank-2026-10-v1 with evidence-grounded reasons.
READ: same four bundles; decisive items E6 (recall table and depth survival), E7 (per-token NLL), E8 (K ceiling), E9 (profile signal), E11 (prefix near-null), E5 (entropy stratification).
OBSERVED: baseline failure is the deepest token (T4 NLL 9.03, T1-3 0.00); the top-scoring SID arms are the euclid/l1_only/resample variants (0.062-0.064) while successor_entropy/geodesic/tangent are 0.051-0.055; first-level behavioural signal is weak (0.0907 vs 0.067 null) and capped (0.0822 at K=256).
REASONING: rank by (i) whether the intervention lands on the binding stage, (ii) measured discriminativeness of the behaviour signal, (iii) whether the curved op is inside the quantiser rather than beside it, (iv) degeneracy risk under one no-tuning run. CURVCTRL is the only per-level design and lands on T4 -> 1; LORENTZ has the best behaviour evidence and moves the quantised point -> 2; succboost is sound geometry but E6's successor_entropy arm is a direct negative prior and it loads the failing deep levels -> 3; behcone targets level 1, which E7/E6 show is already perfect, and is the nearest to an auxiliary loss -> 4.
ANSWER:
RANK: CURVCTRL-SID | position=1 | reason=E7 shows the frozen baseline's entire deficit sits at the deepest token (l1_br T1..T4 NLL 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03 with E6 gold level-1 prefix alive 1.000), so the only mechanism that derives a per-level curvature and hands the measured Q_l into that same level's assignment and commitment metric is the only one aimed where the generator actually fails, with no added loss term and a real closed loop (Q_l -> c_l -> metric -> assignment), though at levels >=2 Q_l collapses toward Q_min so c_l sits on its 0.99/max||z||^2 cap and the loop risks degenerating to fixed curvature.
RANK: LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ | position=2 | reason=it carries the best-grounded behaviour signal in the bundle (E9: 0.9291 vs 0.8871 cohort sharing for positives over negatives, and the positive's profile overlap beats all ten negatives for 0.5898 of pairs) and intervenes on which point is quantised, the axis where E6's best arm resample (0.06363) sits; but its twin relation is the outgoing successor profile whereas E9 measured a predecessor/context profile, and E8's K=256 first-level ceiling of 0.0822 against the baseline's 0.0907 (E11) leaves little level-1 headroom to buy.
RANK: succboost-geoshift | position=3 | reason=E5's entropy stratification is strong (top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543, Spearman -0.973) and the exp-map plus d_P genuinely lives inside assignment and the residual chain, but E6 already measured an entropy-conditioned SID (successor_entropy 0.05122, second worst of eight and below every euclid/l1/resample arm) and the radial push loads diffuse items into exactly the deep levels whose T4 NLL is 9.03, with encoder cancellation left unmitigated.
RANK: behcone-prefix-rq | position=4 | reason=it spends an auxiliary cone loss on level 1, the stage the evidence says is already solved (E7 T1 NLL 0.00, E6 gold level-1 prefix alive 1.000) on a level whose behavioural signal is only 0.0907 against a 0.067 permuted null (E11) and whose K=256 capacity ceiling is 0.0822 (E8); it also keeps the Euclidean quantiser and adds a hyperbolic term beside it, the closest of the four to a standalone hyperbolic loss.
